title: Knowledge-base note front matter
description: The front matter of a note under kb/ (design part 8.3), read by `hitld kb`. A note is a markdown file in the project's documentation, not a data file of HITLd's, so it carries no schema_version. The generated files (kb/index.md, kb/areas/<area>/index.md when the index is split, and kb/decisions.md, each with the generated mark on its third line) carry no front matter.

summary.description: One line: what the note covers, at most 200 characters with no control characters or line breaks. The index lists it beside the note's path, with markdown and HTML escaped.

areas.description: The areas the note belongs to. The index groups the note under the first.

owner.description: The person accountable for the note's accuracy.

checked.description: The date the note was last verified, for people.

checked_at.description: The merged commit the note was verified against, for scripts. A note is stale when a file matching its sources changed since, or when this commit is not reachable from HEAD.

sources.description: Globs relative to the repository root: what the note points at. With none, the note is stale after kb.max_age_unsourced days.

links.description: Other notes, as paths relative to this note.

supersedes.description: Notes this one retires, as paths relative to kb/. The index omits them and `hitld kb links` reports links that still point at them.

classification.description: The index and search show only public notes. A note with none takes the repository's label, as the commit guard reads it (tracker.json default_classification), and none at all when that is unknown; the commit guard holds the repository's ceiling (design 10.3).
